content.title: 2026 Sundance Film Festival
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia 2026 Sundance Film FestivalLocationPark City, Utah and Salt Lake City, UtahFounded1978Hosted bySundance InstituteFestival dateJanuary 22 to February 1, 2026LanguageEnglishWebsitefestival.sundance.orgSundance Film Festival2027 Sundance Film Festival 2025 Sundance Film Festival The 2026 Sundance Film Festival took place in Park City and Salt Lake City, Utah from January 22 to February 1, 2026.[1][2] Film premieres at the festival were held from January 22 to January 27, 2026.[1] The first selection lineup was announced on December 10, 2025.[3] The festival would be the last Sundance Film Festival held in Utah before the festival relocates to Boulder, Colorado in 2027.[2] Several films notably received standing ovations during the festival, including Fing, Josephine, Wicker, The Invite, Levitating, and Union County.[4][5][6] U.S. Dramatic Competition[edit] World Cinema Dramatic Competition[edit] U.S. Documentary Competition[edit] English title Director(s) Production Country American Doctor Poh Si Teng United States, State of Palestine, Malaysia, Qatar American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez David Alvarado United States Barbara Forever Brydie O'Connor United States Joybubbles Rachael J.
